text: Art therapy (AT) is a non-pharmacological complementary intervention that integrates biological, psychological, and cultural dimensions of healing through creative expression. This narrative review aims to synthesize the historical evolution, theoretical foundations, and clinical applications of AT, proposing a neuro-psycho-cultural framework to elucidate its therapeutic mechanisms.
source_label: Healing potential of art therapy: a narrative review of neuro-psycho-cultural mechanisms in mental health
